scenarios.name: Standard Indoor Office Light
scenarios.guideline: Recommended. Position subject directly facing the terminal camera with even overhead lighting.

scenarios.name: Low-Light / Dim Environment
scenarios.guideline: Toggle Low-Light Boost. The screen brightness will automatically pulse white to act as a fill light during enrollment.

scenarios.name: Severe Backlighting
scenarios.guideline: Avoid strong light sources directly behind the user. Re-orient the device angle to prevent face washouts.

scenarios.name: Side Angle / Ambient Shadowing
scenarios.guideline: Avoid heavy shadows on half of the face. Ask user to rotate towards the light source to ensure symmetrical features.
